The booth

Ziryab was a singer in Baghdad. He moved to Spain in 822. He added a fifth string to the oud. He started the first school for music.
You host the school podcast. Today's show is about Ziryab. You are in the booth alone. The run sheet is empty. You need four times to fill it. Four people each know one time. No one knows all four.
You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.
